guestBioOfficial.en: Sanchan Saxena is VP of Product at Coinbase. Before Coinbase, Sanchan was Head of Product and GM at Airbnb, founder and Head of Product of Instagram Shopping, Director of Product Management at Yahoo, and Lead PM at Microsoft.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 桑钱·萨克塞纳现任Coinbase产品副总裁。在加入Coinbase之前，他曾在Airbnb担任产品负责人和总经理，创立并领导Instagram Shopping产品团队，还曾在雅虎担任产品管理总监，并在微软担任首席产品经理。

title.en: Sanchan Saxena (VP of Product at Coinbase) on the inside story of how Airbnb made it through Covid; what he’s learned from Brian Chesky, Brian Armstrong, and Kevin Systrom; much more
title.zh: 桑钱·萨克塞纳（Coinbase产品副总裁）将分享Airbnb如何度过新冠疫情的内部故事；他从布莱恩·切斯基、布莱恩·阿姆斯特朗和凯文·西斯特罗姆身上学到的经验；以及更多内容。

summary.en: Sanchan shares the inside story of how Airbnb navigated COVID when travel stopped, and the lessons he learned from working alongside exceptional CEOs like Brian Chesky, Brian Armstrong, and Kevin Systrom. He covers how to set up a product development process at a startup, when to hire your first PM, and when (and when not) to A/B test. The episode is full of hard-won wisdom from scaling products at the world's top companies.
summary.zh: Sanchan 分享了 Airbnb 在疫情导致旅行停摆时如何渡过难关的内幕，以及他与 Brian Chesky、Brian Armstrong、Kevin Systrom 等杰出 CEO 共事所学到的经验。他涵盖了如何在初创公司建立产品开发流程、何时招聘第一位 PM，以及何时（以及何时不）该做 A/B 测试。本期充满了在世界顶级公司规模化产品过程中锤炼出的硬核智慧。
